snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies - PC Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies launches May 21st 2026 on Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG.

Play with full English voice-over and text localisation in four languages: German, Spanish (Latin America), Chinese (Simplified) and Russian, with eight additional languages to be added in future free updates: 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2863680/view/531001397838087519

Wishlist now to be notified: https://tr.ee/wishlistzeroparades

The game releases on PlayStation®5 (PS5®) later this year.
